_comment: hk_root_descriptor_table of Mesa 26.0.x (offsetof() on the built driver, 26.0.3). Word = 32-bit word index.
The driver preloads u0_u1 = the table's own address and u2_u3.. = sets[0..set_count) (agx_usc_uniform(0,
4 * (1 + set_count) halves, root_ptr); sets follow root_desc_addr for that). Storage-buffer descriptors are
hk_buffer_address {u64 base, u32 size, u32 zero}, 16 bytes per binding.
Mesa 25.3.6 (the M2's driver) differs: its push constants start at root word 124, not 122 (every recorded
preamble in spirv/expected/*/code loads push word n from 124 + n); see spirv/root_layout.mesa-25.3.json.
